tickerText: [TENNIS] Djokovic lifts a record seventh China Open in Beijing after Alex de Minaur retired with an adductor injury trailing 7-6(3), 0-1—Novak's 102nd title and 34-0 in the capital • [SQUASH] CIB Egyptian Squash Open qualifying rolls on at OWest ahead of the Pyramids main draw Oct. 10–16 as defending Diamond champs Hania El Hammamy and Mostafa Asal await round one • [BADMINTON] Arctic Open day two in Vantaa: Tanvi Sharma upset Chiu Pin-chian 21-15, 21-17 and PV Sindhu beat Wen Yu Zhang 21-8, 21-11 as Li Shi Feng and top seeds advance • [PICKLEBALL] Veolia Chicago Cup pro round of 32 Wednesday at Life Time Northbrook—1,500-point indoor Cup with shuttles from off-site parking and PickleballTV from 2 p.m. CT • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT China Smash final day in Beijing: Guo Guanhong stunned Liang Jingkun 3-1 in the men's 16; Sun Yingsha faces Orawan Paranan as mixed doubles and doubles wrap the Grand Smash

newsItems.title: Djokovic Claims Seventh China Open
newsItems.excerpt: Novak Djokovic won his 102nd ATP title when Alex de Minaur retired injured in the Beijing final, extending Djokovic's perfect 34-0 record at the China Open.

newsItems.title: Egyptian Open Qualifying Continues
newsItems.excerpt: Second-round qualifying at OWest narrows the field before the PSA Diamond Egyptian Open shifts to the Pyramids glass court starting Oct. 10.

newsItems.title: Chicago Cup Hits Round Of 32
newsItems.excerpt: The Veolia Chicago Cup's pro draw opens its round-of-32 session Wednesday indoors in Northbrook, with 1,500 ranking points on the line in each division.

newsItems.title: China Smash Closes With Upset
newsItems.excerpt: On the last day of WTT China Smash, Taiwan's Guo Guanhong beat Liang Jingkun 3-1 while Sun Yingsha and the remaining doubles fields played out in Beijing.
